status: Development hypotheses fixed before this round of fits; all source measurements have already been inspected. Not blind preregistration.

staged_changes.cutlass_depth: Prior 7-term fused model and separate host models, unchanged numeric baseline.
staged_changes.launch_detail: Add exact per-execution cudaFuncSetAttribute opt-in call count / 16. Confounded with all grouped-N-only resource changes; coefficient is not an API microbenchmark.
staged_changes.partition_detail: Add unique A footprint per K partition and logical B reads across M tiles. Preserve total A reads: partitioning K does not divide aggregate read bytes by q.
staged_changes.service_detail: Add SM-spread deficit max(1-CTA_count/108,0) and q-1 serial boundaries per output tile. These distinguish lost available parallelism from CTA overhead, and chain depth from aggregate output bytes. SM spread is an upper-bound geometry proxy, not achieved occupancy.

resource_audit: Verify frozen CUDA launch source, compiled register dump, dynamic shared-memory type sizes and binary hash. Record raw resource bounds, not cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor results.
identifiability: Registers, warps, shared-memory size and opt-in count vary only with g in these two kernel families. Audit affine collinearity; do not assign separately fitted physical costs to all of them.
data: Same frozen 2026-10-21 package, 69 primary configurations, 63 stable configurations; no new GPU labels.
quality_rule: Unchanged whole-configuration quality filtering; retain every raw sample and score flagged configurations separately.
loss: Unchanged nonnegative squared-microsecond objective and per-shape weighting. Fixed 1e-6 ridge. At most 12 features, 4096 faces per solve, 10-second per-fit limit. No optimizer or regularization search.
validation: Whole-shape leave-out plus in-sample residuals, candidate pair direction/regret, exact candidate support, unregularized rank, and fixed staged ablations. Additional fused-only leave-M-out stress test; unavailable hosts not fabricated.
report: All staged results, including regressions. No silent promotion based only on in-sample fit.

new_policy_scenarios.status: Assumption sensitivity only; kernel source and old measurement identities remain unchanged.
